_method: derive_strategy_rule_view, one platform section per probe, 22 probes. The four zero-yield sections in the last probe were measured jointly: membership is a union, so an empty union proves each member individually empty.
_rule: A platform section feeds EXACTLY ONE signal module, or none. Every feeding section's measured signal count equals its module's full size - including the htf_/ltf_ rung variants. Platform sections and custom columns reach the same 77 signals; neither reaches CONFLUENCE or COMPARISON.
_correction: docs/07 previously called platform sections 'inconsistent' because includeRsi yields 8 and includeMtfConfluence yields 0 despite carrying MA_ALIGN, RSI14 and ADX columns. That is not inconsistency: CONFLUENCE is a synthesis module fed by other signals firing, so no section can feed it. The mapping is exactly 1:1.

sectionsFeedingNothing.includePriceAction: price columns feed no scorecard module; price is read implicitly by the divergence signals
sectionsFeedingNothing.includeSubTimeframe: a rendering timeframe, not a signal source
sectionsFeedingNothing.includeHigherTimeframe: does NOT feed htf_*; those come from RSI / MOVING_AVERAGES / TREND_STRENGTH
sectionsFeedingNothing.includeMtfConfluence: CONFLUENCE is kind:synthesis - it fires off other signals, never off a section
sectionsFeedingNothing.includeCrowdIntelligence: every CROWD_* metric is read-only context
sectionsFeedingNothing.includeMarketBreadth: COMPARISON is fed by the comparison coin set, not by a section
sectionsFeedingNothing.includeReferencePairs: COMPARISON is fed by the comparison coin set, not by a section
